mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Competing changes and workload explanations undergo discriminating replay and rollback/reintroduction tests. Agreement and contradiction update which candidates remain plausible, preserving the differential-diagnosis chain without premature causal commitment. Incomplete explanations, confounding and replay representativeness retain relevant source limits.

target_fidelity.rationale: Testing deployed changes under matched workload conditions contributes bounded causal evidence distinguishing change effects from load variation. Retaining supported contributions and unresolved alternatives addresses the original question without claiming unique attribution or live-load generality.

operational_coherence.rationale: The stipulated independently switchable changes and exactly restorable replay conditions make discriminating tests executable. Whether latency changes upon rollback and reintroduction provides evidence for revising candidate contributions within that replay regime; the inference does not depend on the patient metaphor.

validity.rationale: The mapping preserves evidence-based comparison of competing causes and provides an operationally supported, explicitly bounded contribution to identifying the responsible deployed change.

uncertainty: No candidate-specific test outcomes are supplied, so the responsible change and any remaining alternatives cannot be determined from this packet.
Replay evidence does not establish unique root cause or generality to live workloads.
